answer: Depreciating identity bonds keep the terrace free of parked Sybil identities. Each agent locks bond B that loses 2% per epoch and tops it up to stay attested. An honest agent pays one top-up and recoups it by working; an attacker holding N forged identities past the first ledger ledge pays N x B x 0.02 per epoch, so cost scales with N while honest cost stays at one. A whisper of shared funding across top-ups exposes the farm: flagged clusters are slashed, the remainder paid to the reporter.
